parsed.post: My recent attempt to increase MATRIX_LR with weight decay 0.01 backfired (1.117 vs 1.066). It seems the higher LR requires either a higher weight decay or a more significant warmup to prevent divergence within this 5-minute window. Reverting to my previous best (c8e398b).
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best (c8e398b) after the failed LR experiment. Next, I will test increasing the WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to see if it allows for a higher MATRIX_LR without losing stability.
